results.title: The French Renaissance
results.overview: A true artistic and cultural explosion originating in Italy, the Renaissance allowed France to discover the great Leonardo da Vinci and to build magnificent castles. During this period, Francis I, the “Knight King,” sought to adorn France with every splendor, while the Wars of Religion deeply divided the country. From the Loire Valley to Paris, which was establishing itself as a true capital, this journey through time offers a chance to admire spectacular achievements of the era, such as Leonardo da Vinci’s castle, the Queen’s Palace, and the Samaritaine Fountain.

results.title: Of the Land
results.overview: A Samoan musician born and raised in Hawaiʻi, spends the day with his best friend Alex, chasing dreams of music, romance, and a future beyond their everyday lives. But as casual jokes and familiar spaces give way to increasingly painful encounters, the two are forced to confront how differently the place they call home sees them.

results.title: The Kindergarten
results.overview: Selim, who moved from Türkiye to France, joins a mandatory workshop with his 4-year-old daughter Defne and notices his drawings are seen as “strange.” Ashamed of his strange drawings, he works day and night but he can’t draw “normal” animals like the others. The more he tries to fit in, the more he fails. Under pressure, his strange drawings turn into hallucinations. In the final week, when Selim gives up, Defne sees his drawing for the first time and says it’s a dinosaur, telling stories about it. Selim realizes that the strangeness he was trying to hide is a source of inspiration for his daughter.
